To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the nonlinear analysis of the ductile fiber reinforced shear walls under cyclic load is reliable and the performance parameters of ductile fiber concrete shear wall are suggested.
the performance of the shear wall is influenced by the height and strength of ductile fiber-reinforced concrete, as well as the shear span ratio and the axial compression ratio.
the nonlinear finite element analysis of ductile fiber-reinforced concrete (DFRC) shear wall under cyclic loading was conducted by using the finite-element software ABAQUStm.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the nonlinear analysis of ductile fiber-reinforced concrete shear walls and the effect of performance parameters for DFRC shear walls.
the nonlinear simulation of ductile fiber-reinforced concrete shear wall under cyclic loading and the effect of performance parameters of ductile fiber concrete shear wall on their seismic behavior.
the nonlinear analysis of DFRC shear walls and the effect of performance parameters on the mechanical behavior of DFRC shear.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the performance parameter of ductile fiber-reinforced concrete shear wall should be determined according to the seismic design requirements of the structure and the characteristics of the local seismicity.
the performance parameters of the DFRC shear walls can be determined by the experimental and finite element simulation results.

, for ductile fiber reinforced shear walls,the shear span ratio is 2.0-3.5,the axial compression ratio is 0.1-0.2,the height of DFRC shear walls is 1.5-3.0 m,and the strength of DFRC shear is 30-40 MPa.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the DFRC shear walls have the excellent ductility and seismic performance,and the DFRC shear wall with the height of 2 m,the shear span ratio of 1.5 and the axial compression ratio of 0.1 has the best seismic performance.

,with the development of DFRC technology,the DFRC shear wall is a promising seismic structure,and the nonlinear finite element simulation is an effective method to analyze the mechanical behavior of DFRC shear walls.

the nonlinear analysis can be used as a reliable tool to predict the behavior of the DFRC shear walls,and the effect of height,strength of DFRC and shear span ratio,axial compression ratio of design of DFRC shear walls can be taken into consideration in the design of the DFRC walls.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the performance parameters of DFRC shear walls are similar to those of ordinary concrete shear walls,except that DFRC has a higher shear span ratio.
DFRC shear wall can be used in high-rise buildings with a high strength of concrete,which is a new type of seismic structure with a good seismic performance.

the shear span ratio and the axial compression ratio of DFRC shear walls should be controlled within the range of 2.5-5.0 and 0.2-0.4, respectively,and the height of the shear wall should be controlled within 5.0 m.
